title: CSI HTS — Horizontal Tab Set
summary: CSI s (or ESC H) sets a tab stop at the current cursor column.

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: the CSI sequence ends at its final byte.

params.name: HTS
params.meaning: CSI s sets a tab stop at the current column.

gotchas: HTS sets a tab stop at the current column; HT (TAB, 0x09) advances to the next tab stop.
Tab stops can be cleared with TBC (CSI 0g or CSI 3g).
Some terminals use ESC H instead of CSI s.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: CSI sequence renders as a byte-exact sequence with final byte 's'.
